entities.name: Rada Borić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rada Borić is a Croatian politician, scholar, feminist, and women's rights activist. She has served as member of the Croatian Parliament from 2020 to 2021 and since 2024. She is one of the founders and the current vice-president of the New Left political party, and a member of the green-left We Can! party.
